description: This file contains the implementation of the LeaseBasedQueueBalancer class, which manages queue balancing in a distributed Orleans cluster using lease-based coordination. It includes methods for lease acquisition, renewal, release, and responsibility management, along with internal classes and logging.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancer
classes.description: A class that implements a lease-based queue balancing mechanism for Orleans streams, supporting auto-scaling and fault tolerance.

classes.name: AcquiredQueue
classes.description: An internal class representing a queue that has been acquired with a lease, including its order, ID, and lease details.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of LeaseBasedQueueBalancer using dependency injection.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with the provided queue mapper, setting up lease management tasks.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the balancer, stopping lease renewal and releasing resources.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues currently owned by this balancer.
